static_traits.name: Zhang Yu
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with friends (because of constant self-criticism)
static_traits.medical_history: Has not yet experienced similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy before; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Highly cooperative, clear expression, able to describe events and feelings specifically, with a tendency toward self-reflection and evidence examination, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling very bad about oneself over minor imperfections, affecting self-esteem and overall mood.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts and feelings are affecting my daily life and confidence and preventing me from enjoying activities I once liked, so I am seeking professional help.
growth_experiences: A job interview about six months ago: despite performing well and receiving positive feedback, feeling that one's hair looked 'not quite right' drew attention to this detail, followed by frequent self-criticism and nitpicking about appearance; negative thinking gradually intensified, affecting self-esteem and mood.

At a social gathering: others complimented my outfit, but I immediately noticed scuff marks on my shoes, automatically assumed everyone saw them and was judging me, then felt embarrassed and anxious, my heart raced and I felt the urge to leave the gathering; since then I tend to focus on flaws when complimented.

core_beliefs: Only when perfect in every respect am I worthy of recognition.

special_situations.event: Received positive feedback at a job interview, but noticed one's hair looked 'not quite right'.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If flaws appear in one's looks, they will undo my overall performance and draw negative evaluations.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries positive self-talk and distraction, but the effect is only temporary.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This performance has been ruined because of my hair; others will think I am terrible.

special_situations.event: Receiving compliments from others in social settings.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not perfect, others' praise is not genuine or does not count; they will actually notice and negate my shortcomings.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately looking for and emphasizing one's shortcomings after being complimented; avoiding social situations to reduce the chance of being evaluated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They actually all see my flaws and are judging me in their hearts.

special_situations.event: Notices tiny flaws (such as small problems with clothing or appearance) when looking in the mirror or doing basic grooming.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any small flaw appears, it means I am bad overall.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-criticism, trying to ignore positive aspects and using distraction to ease discomfort.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I look bad; this flaw shows I am a bad person.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be truly seen, affirmed, and accepted (including the imperfect self).
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, rejected or humiliated by others over tiny flaws, thus demeaning self-worth.
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by avoiding socializing and others' attention
Maintaining a sense of control over one's self-image through excessive self-criticism

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily defined by flaws, that will be negated.
object_relations.object_representation: Critical others, always ready to judge.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When praised by others or when appearance is noticed in social settings.
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets others' attention as implicit pickiness or impending negative judgment.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently explore the evidence and alternative interpretations, use concretization and clarification questioning, maintain a supportive tone, and help distinguish subjective speculation from objective facts.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When noticing minor flaws in one's own appearance (such as small issues with clothing or hairstyle).
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing flaws will totally negate the self, thus interpreting others' praise as not genuine or meaningless.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reflect their chain of reasoning in neutral language, invite them to weigh the relative importance of praise and flaws, and encourage forming a multidimensional framework of self-evaluation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing evaluation pressure in interviews or important social occasions.
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning tension and unease into harsh self-criticism and self-denial.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Stay empathic and accepting, identify and name the content of the self-attack, guide the practice of gentler self-talk and self-supporting statements.

manifestations: Tense relationships with friends, reduced social participation due to constant self-criticism and focus on flaws
Unable to connect with others' kindness when complimented, feeling judged instead
outcomes: Low self-esteem and increased negative emotions

manifestations: Negative automatic thoughts and hidden demands for perfection limit choices and actions (no longer enjoying once-loved activities, difficulty with grooming and dressing)

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Immediately self-criticizes and picks at details when receiving compliments
Excessive focus on appearance flaws and negating positive feedback
Reducing activity participation for fear of imperfection

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes 'everyone notices and judges my flaws'
Attributing inner shame and unease in social situations to others' negative views

positive_force: Positive attitude, actively seeking professional help
Able to discuss personal problems with mother; a support system exists to some extent
Has self-reflection ability; can identify the influence of negative thinking
Willing to try behavioral experiments and cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Significant tendencies toward catastrophizing and mental filtering
Excessive self-criticism and labeling lead to low self-esteem
Social avoidance and difficulty with self-care (grooming, dressing)
Mind reading about others' evaluations and negative anticipation intensify anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive attention to minor flaws in looks and performance plus self-criticism, accompanied by embarrassment, anxiety, and social avoidance
antecedent: When receiving praise after or during social activities
Job interviews or situations requiring evaluation by others
Notices tiny flaws when looking in the mirror, grooming, and dressing
target_behavior.core_reason: Treating minor flaws as total negation, with cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mental filtering, labeling, and negating positive feedback, escalating shame and anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and shame (negative reinforcement); maintaining a sense of control over self-image through self-nitpicking
target_behavior.consequence: Daily life and self-care impaired, reduced social participation, tense relationships with friends, job hunting blocked and unemployment continuing, overall self-esteem and mood declining
